description.value: When you Raise your Shield, you can bury a runic trap into it, which is set off by the clash of an enemy weapon. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Fortifying Knock], you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Trace Rune]{Trace a Rune} with a damaging invocation on your shield, even if it normally couldn't be applied to a shield. The traced rune doesn't have its normal effect, instead fading into your shield. If you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Shield Block] with the shield against a melee Strike, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Invoke Rune]{Invoke} the Rune as part of the reaction, causing the rune to detonate outward and apply its invocation effect to the attacking creature.
